'''Lucain''' is a [[novice]] in the White Tower. 

== Appearance ==
She is a brunette.

== Activities ==
She is one of the novices who are part of [[Egwene al'Vere]]'s resistance against the invading [[Seanchan]] in the [[Battle of Tar Valon]].
